answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 46833 Country: India Title: taraveeh Question: Whether woman can perform 20 rakats of taraveeh salat in her house individually (without jamath)? Answer ID: 46833 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1110/1116/M=9/1434) Yes, women should perform 20 rak’ah tarawih in their houses individually. Tarawih is sunnah for women too. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
